lines.en: To record your message, begin speaking at the dawn.
Listen, I did something kind of crazy tonight.
Maybe I'm getting my period or something, I don't know.
Anyway, I beeped into your machine
and I heard this message that freaked me out.
You know what? Michelle will tell you the rest.
And I hope that we can just forget the whole thing.
